title: WebSocket messages
description: The ONE realtime protocol (D4): GET /ws?village=<id>&m=<member_token>, one socket per client, JSON text frames, one message per frame, discriminated by `type`. Client → server: hello (first frame, required), ack, action, ping. Server → client: snapshot (always first reply to hello and after any rev gap), patch, event, control (Control Room only), prompt, result, pong, error. Reconnect with backoff 0.5 s → 8 s and send hello with last_rev; server answers with a fresh snapshot. Clients apply patch only if patch.base_rev == local rev, otherwise send hello again.

member_token.description: Member token from POST /auth/redeem or the QR (?m=), or the control token for the Control Room.

view_as.description: 1.3.4 (D21 'View as'). Render this member's view on this socket: the server answers with the snapshot that member would get (role, member_id, spec = views[their view], data resolved for them, identity with view_as: true) and keeps streaming as them. Only honored for the control token (Control Room) or a coordinator's member token for a member of the same village; any other caller gets error{code: not_allowed} and the socket stays as itself. Actions sent on a view_as socket are refused (not_allowed): View as is read-only. Send a new hello (no view_as) to go back.

ack.description: Acknowledge an escalation / incident / banner ('I've got it'). Core writes an ack ledger row.

action.description: Same semantics as POST /v/{id}/actions/{name}. Always gated; the server replies with result{req_id}.

snapshot.description: 1.3.4 adds optional identity (D21 identity chip). Clients fall back to deriving it from role/member_id when absent.

spec.description: Member clients: views[role] only. Control Room: the whole VillageSpec.

now.description: Server clock incl. time-warp; clients render countdowns against it.

data.description: Resolved bindings keyed by the exact bind string used in the view (e.g. 'alerts:active', 'rota:current?member=me'). Value shapes below (patternProperties); keys with ?count carry a number; null clears a key.

^prescriptions:current$.description: 1.3.4 (D22). RefillCard. Never sent to elder views.

^chat:village$.description: 1.1.0 (D16): the last 50 chat rows, oldest first. Never sent to elder views.

identity.description: 1.3.4 (D21). Who this socket is rendering, for the identity chip ('You're Marco · Familia Reyes'). Control Room without view_as: member_id null, name 'Control Room', role control. A judge on the shared family QR gets the helper role with name 'Family'.

name.description: Short display name: the first word of person.name, e.g. 'Marco', 'Carmen'.

village_number.description: The Village line (village.village_number); target of BigButton call_number with action_arg 'village'. Absent until the number is provisioned.

view_as.description: true = this snapshot answers a hello.view_as (the viewer is the Control Room / coordinator, not this member).

bv_prescriptions.description: 1.3.4 (D22). Value of prescriptions:current: the current prescription record for the care recipient with supersession where a dose changed (from med_change ledger rows / Agent Memory fact history). Never sent to elder views (no med names on the elder view).

owner_member_id.description: Who does the refill (on duty that day).

dose_text.description: Display dose, e.g. '10 mg'. Use when the dose isn't a plain mg number.

changed_by.description: Prescriber of the change, e.g. 'Dr. Lee'.

superseded.description: The previous dose, shown struck through ('was 5 mg').

bv_message.description: A village chat row (message.schema.json) as bound to chat:village and carried by chat frames.

meds.description: Only for views with show_med_names; never sent to elder views.

answer.description: e.g. 'Yes. Tonight until 9:30.' / 'No. Ana is on tonight; you're next on Saturday.'

status.description: Live chip text: '2/2 lids today', '1 scam stopped', 'Marco on duty'.

need_ids.description: 1.3.4: the blueprint.needs ids this area covers (the kit derives tabs from it).

highlight.description: Element ids to flash as NEW.

data.description: Binding values that changed because of this row (same keys as snapshot.data).

prompt.description: Sent only to the claimed member's sockets (in-app 'Village is calling you' verification). Answer with action answer_verification.

closed.description: true = dismiss the prompt (answered elsewhere or deadline).

kind.description: 1.3.4: verification (default) or an ask from Village to this member (Yes · Can't).

chat.description: 1.1.0 (D16). One new village chat row, fanned out to every member socket whose view is not elder, plus control. Clients append it to the chat:village binding (keep the last 50). A member's own POST /villages/{id}/messages is echoed back as a chat frame too (dedupe on message.id).

error.description: Sent before the server closes the socket (bad_token, contract_mismatch) or on a bad frame.

kind.description: 1.1.0 added proposal and blueprint. 1.3.4 added caption (live call turn es/en for the projector, D18) and ledger (agent work rows: time · status · what · result, D20/D23).
decision = a row of the DecisionsLog (agent autonomy).

items.description: Contract-shaped objects for the stage: village_spec person / need / life_area for people | needs | life_areas; {rule} strings for rules; {kind} for kind; {question} for questions; {rev} for done.

question.en: Did you just call Mamá asking for $2,000?

detail.en: Someone on the phone said they were you and that you're in trouble. She hasn't sent anything.
